steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: ...This is way beyond my expectations...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Explosions, rioting, fires, fighting in the streets...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Has Chernobog completely fallen into chaos?

steps.name: TV Host
steps.text: Thanks to the swift response and teamwork of the Chernobog Military Police...

steps.name: TV Host
steps.text: ...the situation is largely under control. The incidents in most areas have already been contained.

steps.name: TV Host
steps.text: Currently, the Military Police has already surrounded the thugs who had taken Vaschuk Prospect.

steps.name: TV Host
steps.text: As you can see, this senseless violence is about to be put to an end.

steps.name: TV Host
steps.text: Please do not panic. Stay indoors, and await another victory for Chernobog...

steps.name: TV Host
steps.text: May the glory of Ursus bless the Emperor and his people!

steps.name: Ursus Guard
steps.text: Curse them... where the hell did they get those kinds of equipment and weapons?!

steps.name: Ursus Captain
steps.text: Don't get scared! Cowards in armor are still just cowards! They're just a bunch of untrained thugs!

steps.name: Ursus Guard
steps.text: But... there are so many of them...! !

steps.name: Ursus Captain
steps.text: We've already taken out forces three times the size of ours! Just do it again, and the battle will be over!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Enough with the nonsense, Chernobog scum!

steps.name: Ursus Captain
steps.text: You filth think you can stand against us? !

steps.name: Ursus Captain
steps.text: Exile and hard labor are too good for your kind. We should have executed the lot of you the moment you were captured!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: How dare you...! !

steps.name: Ursus Guard
steps.text: Ugh...! They're rushing us again. Our front lines won't hold out much longer!

steps.name: Ursus Captain
steps.text: For the Emperor! Stand your ground! !

steps.name: Ursus Guard
steps.text: I... I can't do it anymore...!

steps.name: Ursus Captain
steps.text: Anyone who turns tail will be executed on the spot!

steps.name: Ursus Guard
steps.text: *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: We have to...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Stay put! We must not expose ourselves yet!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The Ursus guards... are getting overwhelmed by Reunion?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Hmph... What they're broadcasting on television can't be farther from the truth.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Even in this situation, the Chernobog authorities are still playing their games.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: But things are getting worse for us too. We can't expect to sneak out anymore.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Terrible road conditions and enemy blockades... We won't be able to use our own vehicles anymore...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: That's right. The rescue team must be large enough to clear out any Reunion members that block our way.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Splitting up any further would be suicide.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: These Ursus guards...

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: They might look powerful because they're well-equipped, but Reunion...

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Reunion clearly has an overwhelming advantage in numbers and morale!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: This is nothing like when we first investigated Chernobog...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: When we sneaked in, the quantity, distribution, and status of Chernobog's guards and military were in a very bizarre state.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Back then, we just couldn't figure out why.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Had Reunion already destroyed most of Chernobog's defenses at that point?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Though I don't have any proof, if Reunion has grown powerful enough to launch such a large-scale operation...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: ... All I can say is that I feel lucky those guards are being surrounded, instead of us.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Of course, we must be vigilant of our surroundings. By the time we end up in a crisis, it'll already be too late--

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ... Doctor, hurry and gather your teams.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Our scouts have discovered Reunion forces. They're about to come in contact with our rescue team!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: For now, being cautious is the only advantage we can get.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Why is there an armed force here? !

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: All teams, prepare for combat! Don't give them any chance to retaliate!
